docs.description: Determinate linear progress / usage meter. Track = surface/muted; set completion by resizing the Indicator layer (width = % of track). Variants by feedback: neutral (default, action/primary), info, success, warning, danger — bound to surface/feedback/*/strong. Pair with an external numeric label; announce completion via aria-live=polite. See also Skeleton, Spinner.

rules.reason: Each platform's own determinate progress bar, restyled by the recipe: the track's colour and height, the bar's colour by feedback, and both rounded. The progressbar role and its value are the platform's.
The bar's length is the value, and Figma draws each feedback at a sample of its own (40% for neutral, 60% info, 100% success, 90% warning, 95% danger): the caller's value in code.
A progress bar spans its container: Figma draws it 200 wide, a sample. The caller sizes it.
The track is 6 tall and bound to nothing: SOLAR has no progress bar height. Raised as a governance gap.
